name: Robotic Unit Equipment
summary: Modular unit equipment centered around robots, flexibly configurable and integrable according to process requirements.
contentHtml:
Robot cell equipment is modular automation equipment developed by TXAM for flexible production.

Working Principle

The equipment is centered around a six-axis robot, paired with various end-of-arm tools and auxiliary devices to form a modular cell. It can be flexibly configured according to different process requirements, enabling multi-purpose use of a single machine.

Technical Advantages

  • Modular design, flexible configuration
  • Multi-purpose use, improving equipment utilization
  • Easy integration into existing production lines
  • Efficient and reliable, easy maintenance
